question_stem: A wire $X$ has a constant resistance per unit length of $3.0\Omega\text{m}^{-1}$ and a diameter of $0.48\text{mm}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Calculate the resistivity of the metal of wire $X$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.part_stem:
The wire $X$ is connected into the circuit shown in Fig. 6.1.

{{figure:figure_6_1}}

Fig. 6.1

The battery has an electromotive force (e.m.f.) of $5.0\text{V}$ and an internal resistance of $2.0\Omega$. The wire $X$ and a resistor $R$ of resistance $4.5\Omega$ are connected in parallel. The current in the battery is $1.6\text{A}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Calculate the potential difference across resistor $R$.
